body.name: \sim_{G,\mathcal J}
body.def: For \(\omega=(r,\kappa)\) and \(\omega'=(r',\kappa')\), \(\omega\sim_{G,\mathcal J}\omega'\) exactly when \(r=r'\) and \(T_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega)=T_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega')\).
body.role: Explicit response-column equivalence that never mixes canonical branches.
